question: Rahul and Robin are brothers. Pramod is Robin's father. Sheela is Pramod's sister. Prema is Pramod's niece. Shubha is Prema's daughter. How is Rahul related to Shubha ?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fe0a11610b8ab5db98e6b5e8291af3ff13345febe58a0741ab9d8bd6aa8a755.png] 

Now, draw the family tree

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ce94fb95b707df390a83da6f12e0692b92821440b136316b6ce049b8a050eed.png] 

Rahul is cousin of Prema.

So, Rahul is maternal uncle of Shubha.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Maternal Uncle**".
